message: The model bindings (.engine/policies/model-bindings.json) do not match their format — a tier or override is missing its model or effort, or names a versioned model id rather than a durable alias (the exact problem is named just above). This file is the single home for which model realizes each capability tier, read to stamp every persona; a malformed entry would render personas against a broken binding. Fix it to match model-bindings.v1.json before merging.
